transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, what finally made me ask for help is that I just keep forgetting little things that I normally handle fine. Like, I'll forget to return phone calls, or I'll forget to turn in a registration form, or even just stopping for an errand on my way home from work. It's happening enough lately that I figured I should come in and talk to someone about it.
Do you find it hard to concentrate?

Yes, I do. It's really easy for me to get sidetracked. At the office, if a phone rings or I hear people talking nearby, I lose my focus. Even just a random thought popping into my head about something I need to do at home can completely pull me away from whatever I was working on.
Did you have these kinds of attention or forgetfulness problems when you were a child?

Yes, actually. Even back in elementary school, I was always the kid who forgot to bring in permission slips, or I'd somehow lose my homework in the bottom of my backpack. My mother and my teachers always had to remind me, step by step, just to get me to finish my projects. So, yeah, it's been an issue for a long time.
Do these attention and forgetfulness problems cause trouble in more than one part of your life, such as both at work and at home?

Yes, they definitely do. I mean, I’m still getting by, but it affects both. At work, I’ve missed small follow-ups here and there. And at home, I’ll miss deadlines for my kids' school stuff. It’s happening often enough now that I really worry it’s going to start affecting my reputation. I've been hoping to move up into an Office Manager role, and I just don't want this to ruin my chances.
Do you often have trouble organizing tasks or activities?

Yes, I do. I mean, I can usually keep up with things at work, but... well, I recently started taking some evening classes, and it's just gotten really hard to manage. My desk, my class folders, my email reminders—they all just turn into these big piles. I end up wasting so much time just trying to figure out what I'm actually supposed to be doing first.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?

Well, I do notice it a bit, especially during those evening classes I mentioned. When the lectures run long, I catch myself clicking my pen over and over, or I'll be bouncing my foot. I try to just sit still and focus on the teacher, but I end up shifting around in my chair a lot anyway.
Do you often find yourself worrying a lot, even about everyday things?

No, not really. I mean, I worry about getting my work done or messing up my chances for that promotion, but I wouldn't say I worry a lot about just normal, everyday things. It's mostly just the stress of trying to keep track of everything.
Have your attention and memory problems clearly gotten worse compared with how you usually were earlier in adulthood?

No, I don't think they've gotten worse. Honestly, it feels like it's always been about the same. I've always kind of struggled with keeping things straight, it's just more noticeable now because of the extra classes on top of work. But it's not like my memory or attention suddenly took a dive or anything.
